scope: New source-disjoint training and validation of a feature Q_S; no fixed-bank refinement, production change or PPO
target: Uniform selected new source and its one strict-B outcome-blind state; offline conditional bank, not original initialization. Abstentions stay in all-source discovery/yield records.
training: 128 branching roots/state/batch, all two batches and zero states retained. Top 12 P_A^2/Q_A action cells become singleton strata; remaining support is risk-by-LR stratified. Coefficient-minimax counts, no old outcomes, no outcome extension.
fit: Equal-source ridge on shrunk log(J/C). Eleven pre-outcome features, no source IDs, timestamps or outcomes at inference. Four complete-source folds select among three training-only ridges by common-measurement M2 ratio. Model, prior, transforms, training hashes and benefit bet freeze before validation sources open.
validation_design: Frozen model predicts J on common strict-B cases; water-fill q>=alpha/1.1. Benefit uses branching, loss uses plain natural roots with deterministic support/count bounds. Two complete batches with 95% joint conditional-bank objective bounds. Counts exceeding cap stop pre-outcome; no cap increases, extra batches or validation fitting.
review: Require at least five positive measured training sources and OOF point ratio below one to open validation. Validation review requires negative objective upper in both batches and supported paired-source bootstrap ratio upper below one. Bootstrap recomputes normalization from frozen predictions; continuations/leaves never independent sources. This review does not authorize PPO or population acceleration.
artifacts: Exclusive-create output directories, complete outcome-blind schedules, matrices, roots, model, full real-IID state/action likelihood and zero/competing endpoints. Raw outputs/models remain ignored. Failed runs retained and never pooled with a restart.
